statement: Additive composite: the exact files of the base release plus exactly the listed additions. This sidecar is outside the CID payload and nothing in the payload refers to it or to the new CID. Inherited payload metadata (e.g. .well-known/enclave-site-release.json) is BASE metadata describing the base build only; it is not this composition's provenance. This is not a clean build from source.

carImportRewrite.to: data: URL of the pinned unixfs.mjs bytes

source.origin: operator-supplied (--base-source-*), not re-derived by this tool

preservation.method: each base file listed in the inventory was read from the base tree, sha256-checked, copied byte-for-byte, re-imported, and has the identical UnixFS file CID in the base and composite DAGs; the CAR round trip (readCar + walkFiles) reproduced every path/size/sha256
